title: Warm compresses and recovery
abstract: In a randomized trial, warm compresses modestly reduced reported soreness after vaccination compared with usual care.
reference: Warm compresses modestly reduce post-vaccination soreness

title: Vitamin D and winter colds
abstract: Vitamin D supplementation did not reduce the number of laboratory-confirmed winter colds in healthy adults.
reference: Vitamin D does not reduce winter colds

title: Walking after surgery
abstract: Early walking was associated with shorter hospital stays, although residual confounding could explain the association.
reference: Early walking correlates with shorter hospital stays

title: A checklist for pediatric dosing
abstract: We introduce and validate a bedside checklist that reduces arithmetic errors in simulated pediatric medication dosing.
reference: Checklist reduces simulated pediatric dosing errors

title: Remote monitoring for hypertension
abstract: Home monitoring may improve blood-pressure control, but confidence intervals include little or no benefit.
reference: Home monitoring may improve blood-pressure control

title: Antibiotics for uncomplicated cough
abstract: This systematic review finds little evidence that antibiotics meaningfully shorten uncomplicated cough duration.
reference: Antibiotics provide little benefit for uncomplicated cough

title: Sleep and migraine recurrence
abstract: Short sleep predicted migraine recurrence but the observational design cannot establish that sleep loss caused recurrence.
reference: Short sleep predicts but may not cause migraine recurrence

title: Two rehabilitation schedules
abstract: Intensive and distributed rehabilitation produced similar mobility gains at twelve weeks after stroke.
reference: Rehabilitation schedules yield similar twelve-week mobility gains

title: Detecting sepsis from vital signs
abstract: A compact risk score identified impending sepsis earlier than the hospital alert in retrospective records.
reference: Compact score detects sepsis earlier retrospectively

title: Patient narratives in oncology
abstract: Interviews suggest that continuity with one clinician can reduce uncertainty during cancer treatment decisions.
reference: Clinician continuity may reduce treatment uncertainty

title: Urban light and moth activity
abstract: Nighttime illumination reduced moth feeding activity in field enclosures, with larger effects under blue-rich light.
reference: Blue-rich night light reduces moth feeding

title: Drought memory in seedlings
abstract: Previously stressed seedlings showed faster stomatal closure during a second drought, suggesting physiological stress memory.
reference: Prior drought may accelerate later stomatal closure

title: A protocol for single-cell roots
abstract: We present a dissociation protocol that increases viable root cells without changing major cell-type proportions.
reference: Protocol increases viable root cells without composition shifts

title: Microbiome diversity and growth
abstract: Microbiome diversity correlated with plant growth across plots, but fertilizer exposure explained part of the relationship.
reference: Fertilizer partly explains diversity-growth correlation

title: Protein X is not required
abstract: Knockout experiments found that protein X was not required for baseline synaptic transmission in adult mice.
reference: Protein X is not required for baseline transmission

title: Reviewing coral heat tolerance
abstract: This review synthesizes evidence that coral heat tolerance depends on host, symbiont, and prior exposure.
reference: Coral heat tolerance has multiple interacting sources

title: Seasonal bird navigation
abstract: Juvenile birds adjusted headings after magnetic displacement, consistent with but not proving map-based navigation.
reference: Magnetic displacement responses support possible map navigation

title: Enzyme activity at low temperature
abstract: The engineered enzyme retained twice the activity of the wild type at four degrees Celsius.
reference: Engineered enzyme doubles activity at low temperature

title: Pollinator corridors
abstract: Flower corridors increased pollinator visits but did not measurably increase seed production during the study.
reference: Corridors increase visits but not seed production

title: Modeling forest succession
abstract: We develop a spatial model that links seed dispersal constraints to slow forest recovery after disturbance.
reference: Model links dispersal constraints to slow forest recovery

title: Defects in layered conductors
abstract: Controlled defects increased low-temperature resistance while leaving the transition temperature approximately unchanged.
reference: Defects increase resistance without shifting transition temperature

title: A faster spectral solver
abstract: The proposed solver reduces runtime for sparse spectra while maintaining the reference method's numerical accuracy.
reference: Solver accelerates sparse spectra without accuracy loss

title: Cloud feedback uncertainty
abstract: Satellite observations narrow but do not eliminate uncertainty in estimates of shortwave cloud feedback.
reference: Observations narrow cloud-feedback uncertainty

title: No evidence for the predicted phase
abstract: Measurements across the tested pressure range found no evidence for the theoretically predicted intermediate phase.
reference: Predicted intermediate phase is not observed

title: Mapping an ancient river delta
abstract: Sediment profiles are consistent with intermittent river flow, although wind transport remains an alternative explanation.
reference: Profiles may reflect intermittent ancient river flow

title: Review of nanoscale heat transfer
abstract: This review organizes competing models of nanoscale heat transfer and identifies regimes where each is reliable.
reference: Review maps reliable regimes for heat-transfer models

title: Laser stability under vibration
abstract: Active feedback reduced frequency drift during laboratory vibration tests by approximately forty percent.
reference: Feedback reduces laser drift during vibration tests

title: Estimating distant galaxy masses
abstract: A calibrated color estimator recovers simulated galaxy masses with lower bias than two common approximations.
reference: Color estimator lowers simulated galaxy-mass bias

title: Ocean mixing beneath ice
abstract: Tracer measurements indicate stronger mixing near rough ice boundaries than beneath smooth ice.
reference: Rough ice boundaries show stronger ocean mixing

title: A theorem for disordered lattices
abstract: We prove a bound connecting local disorder strength to transport suppression in a finite lattice class.
reference: Theorem bounds disorder-related transport suppression

title: Caching for intermittent networks
abstract: Adaptive caching reduced median retrieval delay in simulations of intermittently connected sensor networks.
reference: Adaptive caching reduces simulated retrieval delay

title: Code assistants and review quality
abstract: Developers using a code assistant completed reviews faster but missed slightly more seeded logic defects.
reference: Code assistants speed reviews but miss more defects

title: A benchmark for multilingual speech
abstract: We release a balanced benchmark and evaluation protocol for speech recognition across twelve low-resource languages.
reference: Benchmark evaluates twelve low-resource speech languages

title: Battery scheduling under uncertainty
abstract: Robust scheduling lowered peak demand in field data, with a small increase in modeled battery degradation.
reference: Scheduling lowers peaks with slightly greater degradation

title: Compression without accuracy gains
abstract: The new compression method reduced model size but did not improve accuracy over matched baselines.
reference: Compression shrinks models without improving accuracy

title: Auditing recommendation exposure
abstract: We introduce an audit that estimates group exposure disparities without access to platform ranking code.
reference: Audit estimates exposure disparities without ranking access

title: Robot learning from corrections
abstract: Occasional human corrections improved task completion in one warehouse layout but not in unseen layouts.
reference: Corrections help one layout but not unseen layouts

title: Review of privacy-preserving analytics
abstract: This review compares privacy guarantees, utility tradeoffs, and deployment assumptions across analytics methods.
reference: Review compares private analytics tradeoffs and assumptions

title: Cooling dense server racks
abstract: Rear-door heat exchangers may reduce cooling energy under high loads, based on a three-month pilot.
reference: Heat exchangers may reduce high-load cooling energy

title: Formal verification of queue fairness
abstract: We prove that the scheduler prevents starvation when arrivals satisfy the stated bounded-burst assumption.
reference: Scheduler prevents starvation under bounded bursts

title: Warm cups and interpersonal judgment
abstract: Participants holding warm rather than cold cups judged a target as warmer, but later replications were mixed.
reference: Warm cups may influence interpersonal warmth judgments

title: Remote work and promotion
abstract: Remote work was associated with slower promotion after adjustment, though self-selection remains a plausible explanation.
reference: Remote work correlates with slower promotion

title: Cash transfers and school attendance
abstract: Cash transfers increased attendance for younger students but produced no detectable change among older students.
reference: Cash transfers raise attendance only for younger students

title: A scale for institutional trust
abstract: We develop a five-item trust scale with stable measurement properties across three survey populations.
reference: Five-item trust scale works across survey populations

title: News labels and belief accuracy
abstract: Source labels did not improve average belief accuracy and slightly increased partisan disagreement.
reference: Source labels fail to improve belief accuracy

title: Reviewing neighborhood effects
abstract: The review argues that selection and measurement choices explain much disagreement about neighborhood effects.
reference: Selection and measurement drive neighborhood-effects disagreement

title: Turn-taking in online meetings
abstract: Shorter speaking turns predicted higher satisfaction, but experimental manipulation yielded uncertain effects.
reference: Short turns correlate with meeting satisfaction

title: Teacher feedback timing
abstract: Next-day feedback improved quiz performance relative to one-week feedback in two introductory courses.
reference: Next-day feedback improves introductory quiz performance

title: Public transit and social connection
abstract: A new rail stop coincided with more cross-neighborhood visits, without clear evidence of stronger social ties.
reference: Rail access increases visits but not clear social ties

title: Modeling collective attention
abstract: The model explains rapid attention decay through competition among topics rather than declining individual interest.
reference: Topic competition explains rapid collective attention decay

title: Metaphor in abolitionist newspapers
abstract: Close reading shows how maritime metaphors framed freedom as both movement and collective obligation.
reference: Maritime metaphors link freedom with collective obligation

title: Revising the archive of early radio
abstract: New station logs complicate the prevailing chronology of regional radio's transition to network programming.
reference: Station logs complicate regional radio chronology

title: A digital edition of coastal letters
abstract: We present an annotated digital edition that links dispersed correspondence while preserving uncertain authorship.
reference: Edition links letters while preserving authorship uncertainty

title: Reviewing translation and empire
abstract: This review identifies a shift from studying translated texts to examining translation as colonial infrastructure.
reference: Review reframes translation as colonial infrastructure

title: Silence in modernist fiction
abstract: The article argues that narrative silence marks contested authority rather than simple psychological repression.
reference: Narrative silence marks contested authority

title: Dating an anonymous manuscript
abstract: Watermark and handwriting evidence suggest, but cannot conclusively establish, an earlier date for the manuscript.
reference: Evidence suggests an earlier manuscript date

title: Against a single authorship
abstract: Stylistic variation does not support assigning the entire poem cycle to one author.
reference: Variation undermines single authorship of poem cycle

title: Mapping performance annotations
abstract: A new taxonomy distinguishes rehearsal, staging, and ownership marks in nineteenth-century playbooks.
reference: Taxonomy distinguishes three kinds of playbook annotations

title: Memory after civil conflict
abstract: Oral histories reveal competing family narratives rather than a shared account of postwar reconciliation.
reference: Families retain competing postwar reconciliation narratives

title: Theory of repair in design
abstract: The essay proposes repair as a framework for understanding maintenance, value, and technological time.
reference: Repair framework connects maintenance value and technological time
